name: Cusa (Herod's steward)
title: Steward of Herod Antipas
summary: Cusa was the steward or household manager for Herod Antipas, tetrarch of Galilee and Perea. His wife Joanna was one of the women who followed Jesus and supported his ministry financially. Through Joanna, the family had a direct connection to Jesus' movement.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Joanna's husband
keyEvents.description: Cusa is mentioned as steward for Herod and husband of Joanna, one of the women who followed Jesus and served him with their resources.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Herod's court
keyEvents.description: As steward for Herod Antipas, Cusa held a prominent position at the court, which made his wife's connection to Jesus remarkable.
